title: ELS Reports Second Quarter Results
summary: Continued Strong Performance CHICAGO, July 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Equity LifeStyle Properties, Inc. (NYSE: ELS) (referred to herein as "we," "us," and "our") today announced results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. All per share results are reported on a fully diluted basis
